about_the_game:
You came for answers. Instead, you found the Fair.

Locked inside a rotting barn and its fairground grounds, you are forced to play by the rules of Lanky, a scarecrow whose games punish more than they kill. Each contest is a carnival trial — familiar, yet corrupted — and every mistake leaves you weaker.

But there are whispers of another presence, hidden behind locked doors. They call her R̴̠̜̊E̶͕̫̦̐̃D̴͕̠͊̑̾Á̵̝̘̦̀̓C̴͙̓T̸͎̙͌̒͝Ȇ̸̹͔͊̏D̵̛̩̰͗. And if R̴̠̜̊E̶͕̫̦̐̃D̴͕̠͊̑̾Á̵̝̘̦̀̓C̴͙̓T̸͎̙͌̒͝Ȇ̸̹͔͊̏D̵̛̩̰͗ wakes, even Lanky may not obey the rules.

Will you survive the fair, or will the fair consume you?

🎮 Features

  • Red Light / Green Light, Distorted
    Hide inside scarecrow cutouts to avoid Lanky’s gaze. Early rounds feel safe, but cutouts decay — splintered, tilted, and unsafe — testing timing and observation.

  • Apple Bobbing — A Fatal Simon Says
    Three colored buckets, flickering bulbs, and a broken memory game. Wrong choices crack bulbs, escalate tension, and bring you closer to suffering.

  • The Price of Failure
    Lanky doesn’t kill you right away. Instead, each failure cripples you — legs snap, sight blurs — forcing you to endure suffering while you continue playing.

  • The Toothpick Gamble
    When no one is left, the scarecrow offers a final test of pure chance: draw the shortest stick. The outcome decides whether you walk or crawl away.

  • Atmospheric Horror Setting
    Explore barns, fields, and fairground arenas where every object hides menace. From above, the layouts reveal something unsettling.

  • A Demo with a Bite
    Survive one of Lanky’s games, endure the festivals secrets, and get a taste of whats to come of INCLOSED.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced in a dark room with headphones.

short_description: A twisted survival horror set in a broken harvest fair. Hide in cutouts during deadly games, endure cruel punishments, and uncover the truth behind the barn before someone awakens.
